visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of seven translucent crystal shrimp dumplings arranged on a blue ceramic plate. The background features a yellow and blue patterned tablecloth. (2) A pair of black chopsticks picks up one dumpling, breaking the skin to reveal the pink shrimp and yellow corn filling inside. (3) A clear glass bowl is shown on a wooden table. A person's hand uses a red spatula to add shrimp paste, corn kernels, and diced carrots into the bowl. (4) The cook adds small amounts of salt, rice wine, and white pepper from small glass ramekins into the shrimp mixture. (5) Hands use a white rolling pin to flatten a small piece of white dough on a wooden cutting board into a thin circle. (6) The cook uses a small butter knife to place a portion of the shrimp filling onto the center of the translucent dough skin. (7) Using both hands, the cook carefully pleats and pinches the edges of the dough together to seal the dumpling. (8) The cook gently presses and shapes the sealed dumpling between their palms to create a smooth, rounded ball shape. (9) Seven uncooked dumplings are placed onto parchment paper inside a round bamboo steamer. (10) The cook places the woven bamboo lid onto the steamer to begin the cooking process. (11) In a small glass bowl, soy sauce, minced garlic, chili paste, and sesame oil are combined and stirred with a metal spoon to create a dipping sauce. (12) The final cooked dumplings are shown again on the blue plate, looking shiny and plump, followed by a final close-up of a dumpling held by chopsticks.
